description: 将 subtype 作为 RustPLC 拓扑 DSL 的标准规范，并精简 examples 资产，降低维护成本同时保持验证回归完整。

userStories.title: DSL 支持 subtype 并兼容 legacy type
userStories.description: As a DSL maintainer, I want `subtype` as a first-class attribute so that device semantics can be expressed explicitly while remaining backward compatible.
acceptanceCriteria: Parser grammar 支持 `subtype` 属性
当仅声明 `type` 时自动映射到 `subtype`
当同时声明 `type` 与 `subtype` 时以 `subtype` 为准并给出迁移提示

userStories.title: 建立 subtype 注册表与兼容矩阵
userStories.description: As a semantic owner, I want a centralized subtype registry so that subtype names, normalization, and base-type compatibility stay consistent.
acceptanceCriteria: 新增统一的 subtype registry 模块
支持 subtype 规范化（大小写、空格、连字符）
定义并暴露已支持 subtype 列表
定义 subtype 到基础设备类型的兼容矩阵

userStories.title: 拓扑语义门禁增加 subtype 校验（SEM-106）
userStories.description: As a safety engineer, I want subtype mismatches to fail semantic gate so that invalid topology semantics are blocked before formal verification.
acceptanceCriteria: subtype 与基础设备类型不兼容时门禁失败
未知 subtype 默认告警并按基础类型处理

userStories.title: 核心样例升级为 subtype 标准写法
userStories.description: As a user, I want canonical examples to use subtype so that I can follow the new standard directly.
acceptanceCriteria: 更新 `examples/two_cylinder.plc` 的按钮与行程传感器 subtype
更新 `examples/assembly_station.plc` 的按钮与关键传感器 subtype

userStories.title: 精简 PIL baseline 样例集合
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want fewer redundant PIL baseline fixtures so that baseline maintenance remains lightweight.
acceptanceCriteria: 保留单个最小可运行 case（timeout）
保留 case 的 scenario 结构与脚本兼容性

userStories.title: 删除重复大型工位示例并收敛覆盖
userStories.description: As a test maintainer, I want to remove duplicated station examples so that test coverage stays meaningful with fewer fixtures.
acceptanceCriteria: 保留 `assembly_station` 作为大型拓扑代表样例

userStories.title: 将单用途演示样例内联到集成测试
userStories.description: As a QA engineer, I want single-purpose demo PLC fixtures inlined into tests so that deleting files does not reduce behavior coverage.
acceptanceCriteria: 将 `half_rotation/delay/repeat/and_or_wait/if_else/custom_states` 迁移为 `tests/examples_integration.rs` 内联 DSL
删除上述 6 个示例文件
保持对应 6 组集成测试语义断言不变

userStories.title: 文档与资产清单同步到 subtype 标准
userStories.description: As a documentation consumer, I want docs to match the new subtype standard so that examples and spec are consistent.
acceptanceCriteria: 更新 subtype 相关规范文档中的 DSL 示例为当前可执行语法
更新 examples 清单与推荐入口，标注保留与内联策略
新增迁移说明：legacy `type` 与 `subtype` 的兼容与优先级
